name: qlrisk_basel25_capital
title: Basel 2.5 market-risk capital
description: Basel 2.5 capital = max(VaR, m x avg60 VaR) + max(SVaR, m x avg60 SVaR), m = 3 + the backtesting plus factor. Give var_series and svar_series (the last 60 daily 10-day figures) and the backtest exceptions, or give trades to compute 10-day VaR, SVaR and the exception count from a history. Example: {"var_series": [1000000], "svar_series": [2000000], "exceptions": 3}.
